description: Primary-source metric definitions, saved-data arithmetic and executed CPU metadata regressions; no new video measurements.

research_object.scope: Metric computation, aggregation and evidence granularity for four-step distilled Wan FFN comparison

inputs.name: saved_native_losses
inputs.semantics: R14N0 per-stripe SSE by action and exposed source

inputs.name: official_metric_implementations
inputs.semantics: Pinned VBench code and primary metric publications

outputs.name: audit
outputs.semantics: Saved scalar decompositions and typed record checks

nodes.operation: Validate measured-record value, mode and provenance

unknown_edges.description: Predictive strength of local errors for full FFNDS video quality on independent sources
unknown_edges.resolving_action: Use paired free-video quality profiles when a distinct candidate is evaluated

derivations.claim: A shared gated response decomposes into mean error and centered contrast error
derivations.implication: Record mean and centered errors independently; native rounding remains a companion measurement

derivations.claim: Dynamic-to-UB1 loss gap equals action-family gap plus selector regret
assumptions: Same frozen finite action set and per-source budgets
derivations.implication: Separately report action quality and routing quality

derivations.claim: Identical adjacent frames receive the maximum static pixel-difference flicker score
derivations.implication: Report motion and condition adherence alongside flicker

experiments.question: How much of the observed gap is action-family versus selection, and source-common versus input-conditional?
experiments.empirical_quantity: Saved R14N0 stripe SSE and R14 median backend latency
experiments.why_not_derivable: The decomposition identity is algebraic; numerical proportions depend on the actual frozen data.

predictions.decision: Measure operator quality separately from selector regret

predictions.outcome: Small action-family gap with large regret

experiments.question: Does the record guard distinguish typed measured claims from incompatible metadata?
experiments.empirical_quantity: Acceptance or rejection of five synthetic metadata cases
experiments.why_not_derivable: Requires executing the actual guard implementation and validating the revised behavior.

predictions.decision: Fix metric-specific values, mode and source bindings

novelty.mechanism_link: Academic metric taxonomy and FFNDS measurement repair; no new model algorithm claimed.

decisions.reason: Use the academically grounded core and task extensions to evaluate FFNDS quality and efficiency.
